calls.title: Lunii & GrowthBook Updates
calls.summary: The discussion centered on assessing GrowthBook's position relative to competitors like VWO and Chameleon, with key points including pricing and language support as main factors influencing customer choice. Caroline raised concerns regarding a price point of 20k and the need for French language support. James confirmed that pricing is a critical factor and announced plans to hire a solutions engineer based in France to enhance client support. The introduction of an AI-driven Visual Editor was highlighted as a competitive feature, nearing release to allow for hands-on testing. A managed warehouse option was discussed to simplify setup for non-technical clients. Plans for a six-month check-in were proposed to track customer experiences and adapt strategies in response to the rising popularity of Chameleon in the market.
calls.keywords: GrowthBook, pricing, French language support, Visual Editor, managed warehouse, Chameleon
calls.action_items:
**James Shannon**
Provide access to the Visual Editor for side-by-side testing with competitor products if Lunii has the time to test it (09:17)
Follow up with Lunii team in six months to check in on experience and updates regarding GrowthBook and Chameleon adoption (10:48)
